Product Features

  • High-gloss tabletop: high-quality high-gloss tabletop with anti-scratch protective film.
  • Innovative glass design: The glass and tabletop blend seamlessly together, creating a modern look.
  • Integrated drawer: provides additional storage space for magazines, remote controls, etc.
  • Robust construction: Made from high-quality materials for long durability.
  • EASY ASSEMBLY: Detailed instructions and protective film for easy assembly.
  • Impact-resistant glass: safe and impact-resistant glass plate for everyday use.
  • MODERN DESIGN: Elegant combination of black and glass, suitable for various interior design styles.
  • Compared to conventional remote-controlled LED light strips, these LED lights use a new control method. You can scan the QR code in the manual, download the app, and use the app to create a smart remote control, effectively preventing the loss or malfunction of the remote.
  • Compared to a traditional wired remote control, this LED light can be controlled via a smart Bluetooth remote control connected to your mobile phone. It features a memory function; once paired, simply enable Bluetooth for automatic reconnection. The color, brightness, and color temperature of the LED light can be selected to suit the environment and time of day. This LED lamp can also be timer-controlled via a mobile app.
